mata_garuda_pipeline._doc: Mata Garuda intelligence pipeline: 4-layer OSINT system. Layer 1=Harvest, Layer 2=Kognitif, Layer 3=Nexus, Layer 4=Action.

mg_sentinel_pulse.description: Mata Garuda Sentinel: daily full pulse (sense→think→act→reflect→dream→mature). Runs all 4 layers sequentially: harvest sources, normalize+score, digest via Claude CLI, publish + TG alert.
mg_sentinel_pulse.consumes: arXiv, RSS, GitHub trending, YouTube, regulation sites

mg_watcher.description: Mata Garuda Watcher: monitors regulation changes and KG data freshness. Alerts if entities become stale or new regulations detected.
mg_watcher.produces: Regulation change alerts, stale entity alerts

mg_bridge_consumer.description: Garuda Bridge Consumer: reads garuda:raw Redis stream, processes intelligence items into Neo4j Knowledge Graph. Uses OSINT-Nexus venv (neo4j 6.1).
mg_bridge_consumer.produces: Neo4j nodes and edges from intelligence items

mg_gap_detector.description: Garuda Gap Detector: runs 8 Cypher queries against Neo4j to find holes in the intelligence graph. Publishes tasks to nexus:gaps stream for future auto-enrichment.
mg_gap_detector.produces: nexus:gaps stream tasks (missing attributes, relations, stale data)

mg_task_consumer.description: Mata Garuda Task Consumer: reads research/enrichment tasks from Redis stream, dispatches to MG agents. Currently mostly log_only (agents for NIP, LHKPN, bio, org chart, LPSE planned).

mg_worker_normalizer.description: Normalizer Worker: reads garuda:raw, deduplicates (SHA256), normalizes to common schema, stores in KB, publishes to garuda:enriched. Layer 2 Kognitif.

mg_worker_scorer.description: Relevance Scorer Worker: reads garuda:enriched, scores items 1-5 using Ollama (local, $0), triggers TG alert for items >= SCORE_SIGNAL. Layer 2 Kognitif.
mg_worker_scorer.produces: Scored intelligence items, TG alerts for high-value items

mg_worker_nlm_feeder.description: NLM Feeder Worker: reads harvested items from KB, adds URLs to appropriate NLM notebooks. Layer 3 Nexus — after 30 days NLM has 300+ sources.
mg_worker_nlm_feeder.produces: NLM sources added to domain notebooks

mg_ai_digest_agent.description: AI Digest Agent: reads KB + Redis data, synthesizes intelligence briefing via Claude CLI (one call), publishes to garuda:digest, sends TG alert.
mg_ai_digest_agent.produces: Intelligence digest, garuda:digest stream entry, TG briefing

mg_regulation_watcher_agent.description: Regulation Watcher Agent: monitors Indonesian government regulation sites for changes relevant to Bali Zero services (visa, company, tax). GENOME-based self-evolving.

mg_twitter_harvester_agent.description: AI Twitter Harvester: monitors X/Twitter for Bali business/immigration/regulation keywords. GENOME-based.

mg_arxiv_harvester_agent.description: arXiv Harvester: harvests AI/ML papers relevant to intelligence operations.

mg_github_harvester_agent.description: GitHub Trending Harvester: harvests trending repos relevant to OSINT/intelligence tooling.

mg_youtube_harvester_agent.description: YouTube Intel Harvester: harvests YouTube videos on Indonesia business/regulation topics.

mg_newsletter_harvester_agent.description: AI Newsletter Harvester: harvests newsletter/RSS sources for business intelligence.

mg_meta_agent.description: Meta Agent: Lamarckian self-evolution engine. Reviews agent GENOME performance, proposes mutations, spawns new agent variants. Uses Claude CLI for reasoning.

mg_source_health_agent.description: Source Health Agent: checks if data sources (URLs, APIs, RSS) are still alive and returning data. Marks dead sources.
mg_source_health_agent.produces: Source health status, dead source alerts

mg_lamarckian_evolution.description: Lamarckian runtime: runs evolution cycles on agent GENOMEs. Reflection→mutation→selection. Stored in SQLite KB.
mg_lamarckian_evolution.produces: Evolved GENOME.md files, KB reflection entries

mg_cli_runtime.description: CLI Runtime: subprocess wrapper for LLM CLIs (claude --print, gemini --prompt, codex). Aligned with bali-intel-scraper enricher pattern. Fallback: claude→gemini.

intel_scraper_pipeline._doc: Bali Intel Scraper: news/regulation scraping pipeline. Runs locally on Pro via OpenClaw at 03:00 WITA.

intel_stage1_scraping.description: Intel Pipeline Stage 1: scrapes 630+ news/regulation sources via Google News RSS + direct sites. Playwright browser pool.

intel_stage2_scoring.description: Intel Pipeline Stage 2: LLAMA local scoring — fast relevance filtering ($0 cost).

intel_stage3_validation.description: Intel Pipeline Stage 3: Claude validation gate — intelligent quality filter.

intel_stage4_enrichment.description: Intel Pipeline Stage 4: Claude Max enrichment — full article generation with SEO/AEO optimization.

intel_stage5_images.description: Intel Pipeline Stage 5: Gemini image generation — cover images for published articles.

intel_stage6_publish.description: Intel Pipeline Stage 6: publish to BaliZero website API + optional Telegram approval workflow.

intel_nightly_orchestrator.description: Intel Nightly: LaunchAgent orchestrates the full pipeline at 01:00 WITA via OpenClaw. Triggers all 6 stages sequentially.

lhkpn_harvester.description: Mata Garuda Layer 1 harvester for LHKPN wealth declarations (antv.kpk.go.id). Dispatched by gap_consumer for 4 gap types: missing_nip, missing_lhkpn, missing_angkatan, stale_official.
